```{r Chapter 1 Example}
# vote share base on economic growth
data(hibbs)
plot(hibbs$growth, hibbs$vote, xlab="Average Recent Growth in Personal Income", ylab = "Incumbent Party's Vote Share")

M1 <- stan_glm(vote ~ growth, data = hibbs)

abline(coef(M1), col="blue")

print(M1)

#comparing LM to Stan_glm
M2 <- lm(vote ~ growth, data = hibbs)

abline(coef(M2), col="red")

stargazer(M2, type = "text")
```


```{r Practicing with MN Election Data}
X1992 <- read_excel("Election Data/1992_results.xls") %>% mutate(year = 1992)
ggplot(X1992, aes(PresDFL/Ballots, Ballots)) + geom_point() + labs(x = "Percentage of Vote For DFL Candidate", y = "Ballots Cast", title = 'DFL Candidate Share by Number of Ballots Cast in a Precinct') + geom_smooth(method = lm)

ggplot(X1992, aes(PresDFL/Ballots, EDR/Ballots)) + geom_point() + geom_abline() + labs(x = "Percentage of Vote For DFL Candidate", y = "Percentage of Voters that Registered Same Day", title = 'Same Day Registration and DFL Candidate Share') + geom_smooth(method = lm)
```

```{r Chapter 5: Simulation}
#sim for average heights
height_sim <- function(N){
  male <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.48)
  height <- ifelse(male==1, rnorm(N, 69.1, 2.9), rnorm(N, 63.7, 2.7))
  mean(height)
}

avg_height <- replicate(1000, height_sim(N=10))

hist(avg_height)

z <- rnorm(1e4, 5, 2)
cat(mean(z), median(z), sd(z), mad(z))
# MAD is median absolute deviation * 1.483 (used in special case of normal distribution) or hand calc as 1.483*median(abs(z - median(z)))


#bootstrapping example with earnings & gender data
data(earnings)
earn <- earnings$earn
male <- earnings$male
ratio <- median(earn[male==0])/median(earn[male==1])


boot_ratio <- function(data){
n <- nrow(earnings)
boot <- sample(n, replace = TRUE)
earn_boot <- earn[boot]
male_boot <- male[boot]
ratio_boot <- median(earn_boot[male_boot==0]) / median(earn_boot[male_boot==1])
}

n_sims <-10000
output <- replicate(n_sims, boot_ratio(data=earnings))
hist(output)
print(sd(output))


```

```{r LODES Data Setup}
library(lehdr)
options(lehdr_use_cache = TRUE)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)



rac <- grab_lodes(state = "mn", year = 2002:2023, lodes_type = "rac",
                  job_type = "JT01", segment = "S000",
                  agg_geo = "block", download_dir = "~/R Files/myrepo/Lodes",
                  use_cache = TRUE, geometry = TRUE)

xwalk <- grab_crosswalk("mn", download_dir = "~/R Files/myrepo/Lodes")

mcd <- rac %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(xwalk, tabblk2020, ctycsub),
            by = c("h_geocode" = "tabblk2020")) %>%
  group_by(year, ctycsub) %>%
  summarise(across(c(C000, starts_with("CNS")), sum), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

mn_mcd <- county_subdivisions("MN", year = 2020, cb = TRUE)   # 2020 boundaries match LODES8

map_df <- mn_mcd |>
  left_join(filter(mcd, year == 2002), by = c("GEOID" = "ctycsub")) |>
  mutate(mfg_share = CNS05 / C000)

ggplot(map_df) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mfg_share), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent, na.value = "grey85") +
  labs(title = "Manufacturing share of residents' jobs, 2002",
       fill = NULL, caption = "LODES8 RAC, primary jobs") +
  theme_void()

X2002_general_results <- read_excel("~/R Files/myrepo/Election Data/2002_general_results.xls", skip = 2)
tibble(X2002_general_results)

```
